description: N2 file-localisation eval: natural-language query -> the file(s) that answer it. 15 queries over this repository (self) and 15 over a small multi-language fixture shop. Run: tug index eval evals/localisation/queries.json

queries.query: where are tool calls extracted from a model reply written as plain text
forgiving match of the old string against the file: line endings, indentation, smart quotes
apply a Codex style patch made of hunks with context lines
rank definitions of the repository with personalised pagerank for the first prompt
decide whether a tool call is allowed, needs approval or is denied
summarise old messages when the context window is almost full
find hidden tools by keywords so they can be activated later
run a subagent in its own git worktree on a separate branch
remove credentials and tokens from the environment before spawning a command
tell the model about syntax errors it introduced right after it edits a file
keep CRLF line endings, the BOM and the final newline when writing an edited file
long running background commands whose output the agent reads later
language server messages framed with a Content-Length header over stdio
connect to MCP servers and expose their tools to the agent
snapshot the workspace so the user can rewind the agent's changes
how is VAT added to an order total after the coupon
turn dollars into dirhams
give part of the payment back to a customer
log the user out after half an hour of inactivity
securely store user secrets with a salted key derivation
nightly job that deletes baskets nobody ordered
email the buyer that we got their purchase
price of delivering a heavy package abroad
has the parcel arrived according to the carrier scans
stop two shoppers from buying the last unit at the same time
add a product to the basket and count items
submit the card payment when the customer confirms
try the request again with growing delays when the server is overloaded
reject a signup with a malformed e-mail or postcode
show the interface in German or Arabic
